Instructions for Use
Device description: The Cobalt SCS System is a spinal cord stimulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5 T or 3.0 T): at 1.5 T: B1+RMS of 3.6 µT or less, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 4 W/kg, No more than 60 minutes of active scan time per session; at 3 T: B1+rms ≤ 2 µT, WB-SAR ≤ 4 W/kg, Scan for up to 30 minutes; First Level Controlled Operating Mode; Head Transmit/Receive Coil ONLY.
